text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (P0) - High tail latency and occasional correctness fallbacks originating from an extremely hot prefix fanout in eu-west-1. Auto-alerts triggered. Potential customer-visible 500s and 30s+ tail latency. Paging oncall.
carla-m: oncall here, ack. paging eng-runtime + sRE. tagging ajay and emily. starting triage.
ajay-p: seeing heavy fanout to kv-prefix shards for prefix `user:hot-42` -> amplified linear fanout. Some requests hitting bypass path causing correctness checks and extra DB trips.
emily-chen: confirmed increased P95/P99 for generation route in eu-west-1 since 09:12 UTC, error rate up ~1.8% from 0.02%. Affected tenants: t-12345, t-9876 (one obvious hot tenant).
sean-r: impact note for support: small set of tenants getting timeouts and retries, others unaffected. I'll draft a customer-facing blurb once we stabilize.
ajay-p: immediate mitigations proposal (short-lived):
- temporarily shepherd hot prefix traffic to a bypass pool with strict per-tenant concurrency limits
- disable prefetch/prefix KV caching for the offending prefix to avoid inconsistent cache state
- apply per-tenant rate cap on t-12345 (drop to 10 rps burst)
- if needed, route ~10% of traffic to cold fallback model to shed load

bob-runtime: agree. steps I can run now:
```
# carve out hot prefix to bypass routing
curl -X POST "$ROUTE_API/evacuate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"user:hot-42","strategy":"bypass","shards":"eu-west-1"}'

# flip prefetch off for that prefix
curl -X POST "$CONFIG_API/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"prefetch_prefix:user:hot-42","value":false}'

# apply tenant rate cap
curl -X POST "$QUOTA_API/tenants/t-12345/cap" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"rps":10,"burst":20,"reason":"live mitigation - hotprefix"}'
```

emily-chen: I'll watch telemetry and set up an anomaly detector for any correctness rollbacks after we flip. Also rolling a short-lived trace sampling to capture 1% of requests for deep debug (stack traces + kv call timings).
carla-m: bob - please run the three commands above, then confirm here. If the bypass reduces tail p99 by >40% we keep until lower-risk config is ready. Ops-bot, notify oncall-policy channel when carveout completes.
ops-bot: runbook step started: INCIDENT-PLAYBOOK -> "handle hotprefix fanout". Pager duty notified group "platform-runtime".
bob-runtime: done - posted responses from APIs, got 202s. Observability now shows initial drop in fanout calls. pulling graphs.
ajay-p: early telemetry: shard-level qps to KV dropped ~65% for the hot prefix, p99 down ~48% in eu-west-1. Error rate for affected tenants down to 0.4%.
emily-chen: correctness regressions: none detected in the 2m after flip. sampling traces show higher DB reads but within limits.
sean-r: writing customer note: "We experienced elevated latencies for a subset of tenants in EU-WEST-1. A mitigation has been applied to limit traffic fanout for a hot prefix; we're monitoring. No data loss. Follow-up postmortem to follow." Will share draft in #support.
carla-m: good. next steps: keep carveout for 45 minutes, work with runtime to throttle upstream generators, prepare rollback plan if things worsen. Create INC ticket and assign to eng-runtime for root cause and long-term fix (rate shaping + better hot-prefix detection).
ajay-p: long-term mitigations I'm assigning: (1) prefix-level adaptive token-aware batching, (2) per-prefix cache admission control, (3) faster safe-bypass automations in the control plane.
emily-chen: logging action items in incident tracker: INC-20260317-77. I'll attach traces and graphs. tagging bob + ajay for follow-up doc.
carla-m: handing off to next oncall at 10:30 UTC. current status: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced, monitoring green. If p95 increases again, escalate to full capacity shift.
incident-bot: Incident update recorded: INC-20260317-77. Handoff: carla-m -> night-oncall. Link to runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/hotprefix-fanout
